items.title: Massive Foundation Model for Biomolecular Sciences Now Available via NVIDIA BioNeMo
items.summary: Scientists everywhere can now access Evo 2, a powerful new foundation model that understands the genetic code for all domains of life. Unveiled today as the largest publicly available AI model for genomic data, it was built on the NVIDIA DGX Cloud platform in a collaboration led by nonprofit biomedical research organization Arc Institute and Stanford University. Evo 2 is available to global developers on the NVIDIA B
items.summaryZh: 由Arc Institute和斯坦福大学合作研发的Evo 2大模型现已通过NVIDIA BioNeMo平台向全球开发者提供。该模型基于近9万亿个核苷酸的数据集进行训练，是目前公开最大的基因组学AI基础模型。它能够预测蛋白质的形态和功能、识别新型医疗和工业分子，以及评估基因突变的影响，为生成式基因组学和生物分子研究带来重大突破。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该文章详细报道了基于NVIDIA DGX Cloud和BioNeMo平台发布的基因组学大规模基础模型Evo 2及其在生物分子研究中的应用。
